note: The bright layer of the game's sound effects. Each one plays TOGETHER with the original deep recording of the same name (public/audio/sfx/<id>.mp3): the original gives the weight, this gives the part you hear. Made with `rundot generate sfx` by scripts/audio/generate-sfx-top.mjs; files are public/audio/sfx/top-<id>.mp3.

sounds.prompt: A toy blaster being reloaded: a plastic magazine slides in and clicks, then a quick spring-loaded cocking ratchet. Crisp plastic clicks, close and dry, no voice, no music.
A single short sweet candy pickup blip: a bright candy wrapper crinkle with a tiny rising two-note chime, cheerful and quick. Starts immediately, no voice, no music.
A friendly two-tone doorbell ding-dong heard from the porch, then a wooden front door creaking open. Suburban house on Halloween night, no voice, no music.
A short cartoon ouch impact with no voice: a dull body thump with a quick descending synth buzz, the player got hurt. One sound, starts immediately, no music.
A fast airy whoosh of a kid dashing: a quick cloth flutter and a sneaker scuff, bright and short. One whoosh, starts immediately, no voice, no music.
A magical power-up burst: a sparkly rising shimmer that blooms into a bright whoosh, 1980s cartoon special ability. One sound, no voice, no music.
A warm uplifting revive chime: three soft rising bell-like synth notes with a gentle sparkle, hopeful, a friend getting back on their feet. No voice.
A big monster arriving: a deep growling brass sting with a spooky theremin wobble on top, a dramatic boss entrance in a 1980s monster movie. No words, no voice.
A satisfying reward jingle: a quick bright ascending arpeggio on a toy glockenspiel ending in a sparkle, arcade prize sound. Short, no voice.
A triumphant short fanfare on bright synth brass with a sparkling tail, 1980s arcade win screen. No voice.
A single crisp menu button click: a small tactile plastic tick with a soft high blip. One click only, starts immediately, no voice, no music.

A small cartoon explosion: a round muffled 'boom' with a soft puff of air and a little crackle of debris, like a big firework going off in a cardboard box. Punchy but not harsh. One single short sound that starts immediately and then silence. Dry, close, no echo, no voice, no music.

One tiny soft tick, like a fingernail tapping a hollow plastic toy. Very short, quiet and dry. One single short sound that starts immediately and then silence. Dry, close, no echo, no voice, no music.

gunNote: One quiet shot sound per gun, played over the deep original 'shot' (public/audio/sfx/gun-<id>.mp3). `max` is how much of the recording is used (seconds), `every` the shortest time between two of them: fast guns tick gently instead of buzzing.
